BEGIN TRANSACTION;

-- Create normalized table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS measurements_normalized (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  session_id TEXT,
  participant_id TEXT,
  condition TEXT,
  metric TEXT,
  value REAL,
  recorded_at TEXT,
  status TEXT,
  notes TEXT
);

-- Insert cognitive_score rows

FROM measurements
WHERE cognitive_score IS NOT NULL;

SELECT session_id, participant_id, condition, 'reaction_ms' AS metric, reaction_ms AS value, recorded_at, status, notes
FROM measurements
WHERE reaction_ms IS NOT NULL;

COMMIT;
